# 多个全身控制命令接口能否由一个低层策略覆盖，而不为每种模式单独训练策略？

> **当前答案：** 在 HOVER 报告的 19-DoF Unitree H1、重定向 AMASS 与同一训练栈中，把关键点、关节角和根命令编码为带模式/稀疏掩码的统一空间，再从全身运动教师做 DAgger 蒸馏，可用一个策略覆盖多种接口，并在论文的同栈对照中优于分别训练的专用策略和相同掩码的多模式 RL；该结果不构成跨机器人或安全关键切换保证。

## 关键术语

- 全身控制（Whole-Body Control, WBC）
- 惯性测量单元（Inertial Measurement Unit, IMU）
- 应用程序接口（Application Programming Interface, API）
- 动作重定向（Motion Retargeting）
- 质心（Center of Mass, CoM）

## 适用机器人

- 19-DoF Unitree H1 in the reported setup

## 适用模拟器

- Isaac Gym

## 控制器与方法

- HOVER multi-mode student
- full-body motion-imitation oracle

## 适用环境

- retargeted AMASS simulation evaluation
- reported 20-motion standing evaluation and qualitative locomotion switching

## 成立假设

- All control modes can be represented by subsets of key-body position, local joint-angle, and root commands.
- A full-motion oracle and retargeted AMASS training data are available.
- Deployment supplies the reported proprioceptive and action history.

## 排查与验证

- 先核对适用机器人、模拟器、控制器、环境和成立假设，再沿下方证据定位复核原始实验或实现。

## 结果

- 在 HOVER 报告的 19-DoF Unitree H1、重定向 AMASS 与同一训练栈中，把关键点、关节角和根命令编码为带模式/稀疏掩码的统一空间，再从全身运动教师做 DAgger 蒸馏，可用一个策略覆盖多种接口，并在论文的同栈对照中优于分别训练的专用策略和相同掩码的多模式 RL；该结果不构成跨机器人或安全关键切换保证。

## 限制

- All control modes can be represented by subsets of key-body position, local joint-angle, and root commands.
- A full-motion oracle and retargeted AMASS training data are available.
- Deployment supplies the reported proprioceptive and action history.

- [HOVER: Versatile Neural Whole-Body Controller for Humanoid Robots](<https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.21229v2>) — `support/primary`；Section II-B/II-E, Figure 2, Table III-IV, Figure 4, and Table V；Defines the atomic masked command space, DAgger distillation, and the reported specialist/generalist comparisons.
- [NVlabs/HOVER official implementation](<https://github.com/NVlabs/HOVER/tree/8088f6cfb42a8f307dc614735197796a86ce8490>) — `support/primary`；create_mask; StudentPolicyTrainer.run, _produce_actions, _get_ground_truth_actions, and _update_student_network at commit 8088f6c；Maps the paper mechanism to public mask sampling, teacher labels, student rollout, and action imitation loss.
